L0.uncertainty_note: Deterministic synthetic DEM for simulation, testing, and offline fallback.

L1.name: Elevation (HRSC/MOLA blend, 200 m)
L1.uncertainty_note: 200 m posting: hazards smaller than ~200 m are not resolved.

L2.name: Elevation (MSL Gale merged DEM, 20 m)
L2.credit: NASA/JPL/University of Arizona (HiRISE), NASA/JPL/MSSS (CTX); USGS Astrogeology MSL Gale merged DEM v3
L2.uncertainty_note: Area-averaged from the 1 m source to 20 m; rocks and boulders smaller than 20 m are not resolved.

L2.name: Walkability index (20 m, derived from the elevation layer)
L2.credit: NASA/JPL/University of Arizona (HiRISE), NASA/JPL/MSSS (CTX); USGS Astrogeology MSL Gale merged DEM v3
L2.uncertainty_note: Derived from the 20 m elevation model only. Objects smaller than the grid cell (boulders, small steps) are not resolved: roughness and obstacle density describe terrain texture at the cell scale only. Weights are assumptions. Cells above the walking slope limit are impassable (W = 0).
